title: Mechano-enzymatic and deep eutectic solvent (DES) mediated sulfoxidation reactions: a comparison study
content:
RSC Sustainability, 2025, 3,4098-4107
DOI: 10.1039/D5SU00467E, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Amina Cheraitia, Chuhan Li, Michele Crotti, Naima Merabet, Daniele Castagnolo
Three approaches were developed to synthesise sulfoxides: mechanoenzymatic, mechanochemical, and DES-mediated methods. Their environmental impact was assessed using green metrics to identify the most sustainable synthetic pathways.
